daily_summary.es: Apple endurece sus normas del App Store contra apps de desnudez no consentida mientras crece la tensión con OpenAI por una filtración de empleado, y en desarrollo destaca el nuevo almacenamiento persistente de Vercel para agentes de IA.
daily_summary.en: Apple tightens App Store rules against nonconsensual nudity apps amid rising tension with OpenAI over an employee leak, while developer tools advance with Vercel's new persistent storage for AI agents.

apple.es: Apple actualizó las App Review Guidelines para prohibir explícitamente apps de 'nudificación' y tácticas bait-and-switch que ocultan funciones dañinas hasta después de la aprobación. Por separado, OpenAI expresó preocupación porque un exempleado que se unió a Apple compartió más de 100 archivos sobre un producto no publicado y luego hizo una presentación a directivos de Apple, en un contexto donde Apple ya lanzó su propio producto de IA, HomeView. Apple también contrató al exabogado de Meta Scott Tucker para liderar su litigio global, y empleados de tienda han sido instruidos sobre la escasez prevista del iPhone Duo en su lanzamiento.
apple.en: Apple updated its App Review Guidelines to explicitly ban 'nudification' apps and bait-and-switch tactics that hide harmful features until after approval. Separately, OpenAI raised concerns that a former employee who joined Apple shared over 100 files about an unreleased product and later presented it to Apple leadership, amid Apple's own AI product, HomeView, already shipping. Apple also hired former Meta lawyer Scott Tucker to lead its global litigation team, and retail staff have been briefed on expected iPhone Duo shortages at launch.

ai_software.es: Vercel lanzó Vercel Drives, almacenamiento persistente para agentes de IA disponible de forma general en Vercel Sandbox, con capacidad por defecto de 1 TiB (1 GiB en el plan Hobby) y hasta 16 TiB, permitiendo a los agentes reanudar tareas entre entornos.
ai_software.en: Vercel launched Vercel Drives, persistent storage for AI agents now generally available on Vercel Sandbox, defaulting to 1 TiB (1 GiB on Hobby) with up to 16 TiB available, letting agents resume tasks across environments.

tech.es: Meta presentó Muse Spark Open, un modelo de IA de pesos abiertos desarrollado junto con Apple para ejecutarse localmente en silicio Apple.
tech.en: Meta unveiled Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model developed with Apple to run locally on Apple silicon.

title.es: Apple endurece las normas del App Store contra apps de desnudez no consentida
title.en: Apple tightens App Store rules against nonconsensual nudity apps

body.es: Apple actualizó las App Review Guidelines para prohibir explícitamente las apps de 'nudificación' que generan imágenes explícitas de personas reales sin su consentimiento, usando fotos aportadas por el usuario. La nueva regla 2.5.19 también prohíbe tácticas bait-and-switch, donde una app oculta sus capacidades dañinas durante la revisión y las revela después de ser aprobada. Las apps que faciliten trata de personas o explotación infantil serán eliminadas y bloqueadas incluso de distribución alternativa.
body.en: Apple updated its App Review Guidelines to explicitly ban 'nudification' apps that generate explicit images of real people without consent using user-supplied photos. The new rule 2.5.19 also bans bait-and-switch tactics, where an app hides harmful capabilities during review and reveals them only after approval. Apps found facilitating human trafficking or child exploitation will be removed and blocked even from alternative distribution.

evidence.claim: Apple has updated the App Review Guidelines to target apps creating non-consensual adult imagery.
Nudification apps that generate explicit images of real people using photos supplied by the user, without the subject's consent, are prohibited by the App Store.
Apps with hidden or undocumented features are not allowed on the App Store.
Apps with bait-and-switch tactics affecting the App Store Review process are banned.
Apps found to facilitate human trafficking or the exploitation of children will be removed from the App Store and blocked from alternative distribution.

title.es: OpenAI denuncia que un extrabajador llevó archivos confidenciales a Apple
title.en: OpenAI says ex-employee carried confidential files to Apple

body.es: Un empleado que dejó OpenAI por Apple envió más de 100 archivos sobre un producto no publicado a una cuenta personal y luego presentó ese material a directivos senior de Apple, según OpenAI. La compañía teme que sus secretos comerciales circulen ahora dentro de Apple y puedan influir en el diseño de sus próximos productos, en un momento en que Apple ya lanzó su propio producto de IA, HomeView.
body.en: An employee who left OpenAI for Apple sent more than 100 files about an unreleased product to a personal account and later presented that material to senior Apple leadership, according to OpenAI. The company fears its trade secrets are now circulating inside Apple and could shape its upcoming products, at a time when Apple has already shipped its own AI product, HomeView.

evidence.claim: An OpenAI employee who left the company for Apple took files about an unreleased product.
The employee made a presentation about the unreleased product to senior Apple leadership.
OpenAI is concerned that its trade secrets and confidential information are now circulating inside Apple.
Apple is now making AI products of its own.

title.es: Vercel lanza almacenamiento persistente para agentes de IA
title.en: Vercel launches persistent storage for AI agents

body.es: Vercel Drives ya está disponible de forma general en Vercel Sandbox para todos los planes, con 1 TiB por defecto (1 GiB en Hobby) y hasta 16 TiB disponibles. Los agentes pueden montar el mismo drive en un nuevo entorno para continuar una tarea donde la dejaron, o preparar archivos una vez y reutilizarlos en múltiples sandboxes, aunque los forks no se fusionan de nuevo con el drive original.
body.en: Vercel Drives is now generally available on Vercel Sandbox for all plans, defaulting to 1 TiB (1 GiB on Hobby) with up to 16 TiB available. Agents can mount the same drive in a new environment to continue a task where they left off, or prepare files once and reuse them across multiple sandboxes, though forks don't merge back into the original drive.

evidence.claim: Vercel Drives is now generally available for Vercel Sandbox on all plans.
Drives default to 1 TiB, or 1 GiB on Hobby, with up to 16 TiB available.
Agents can mount the same drive in a new environment configured for the next task and continue where they left off.
Forks don’t merge back into the original drive.
Agents can prepare files on a drive once and reuse them across sandboxes.

title.es: Meta lanza un modelo de IA de pesos abiertos que corre en Macs
title.en: Meta launches open-weight AI model that runs on Macs

body.es: Meta y Apple se han asociado para el lanzamiento de Muse Spark Open, el nuevo modelo de IA de Meta que funcionará de forma local en silicio Apple. La colaboración apunta a llevar capacidades de IA de Meta directamente a dispositivos Mac sin depender de servidores en la nube.
body.en: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of Muse Spark Open, Meta's newest AI model, which will run locally on Apple silicon. The collaboration aims to bring Meta's AI capabilities directly to Mac devices without relying on cloud servers.

evidence.claim: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open.

title.es: Apple contrata a un exabogado de Meta para liderar su litigio global
title.en: Apple hires former Meta lawyer to lead global litigation

body.es: Apple ha contratado a Scott Tucker, antiguo abogado de Meta, como nuevo vicepresidente de litigio global y servicios financieros, un puesto que supervisará demandas comerciales, disputas de patentes y asuntos legales de sus productos financieros. Como parte de la reorganización, Heather Grenier pasará a reportar a Tucker en lugar de a Newstead, mientras que las responsabilidades del ejecutivo legal Kyle Andeer se amplían a asuntos internacionales, seguridad infantil, ciberseguridad y aplicación de la ley.
body.en: Apple has hired former Meta lawyer Scott Tucker as its new vice president of global litigation and financial services, a role overseeing commercial lawsuits, patent disputes and legal matters involving its financial products. As part of the reorganization, Heather Grenier will now report to Tucker instead of Newstead, while legal executive Kyle Andeer's responsibilities expand to cover international legal matters, child safety, cybersecurity and law enforcement.

evidence.claim: Apple has hired Scott Tucker to lead its litigation team.
Scott Tucker will become Apple's vice president of global litigation and financial services.
Heather Grenier will report to Tucker instead of Newstead.
Apple is expanding legal executive Kyle Andeer's responsibilities to include international legal matters, child safety, cybersecurity, and law enforcement.

title.es: Apple avisa a su personal de tienda sobre la escasez del iPhone Duo
title.en: Apple warns retail staff about iPhone Duo shortage

body.es: Empleados de Apple Store han recibido instrucciones de desanimar a los clientes sin pedido previo a acudir a comprar el iPhone Duo, ya que probablemente no habrá stock disponible para compras sin cita el día del lanzamiento. La producción del dispositivo sufrió varios problemas: a finales de agosto apenas se fabricaban unos pocos cientos de unidades diarias, y Apple llegó a temer que las limitaciones de producción retrasaran el inicio de las ventas hasta noviembre.
body.en: Apple Store employees have been instructed to discourage customers without pre-orders from coming in to buy the iPhone Duo, as there will likely be no stock available for walk-in purchases on launch day. The device's production faced several issues: by late August output had reached only a few hundred units per day, and Apple had at one point feared production constraints could push the start of sales into November.

evidence.claim: Apple retail employees have been instructed to discourage customers without pre-orders from visiting to purchase the iPhone Duo.
The iPhone Duo's production faced several issues, with production reaching only a few hundred devices per day in late August.
Apple had initially believed production constraints could push the start of sales into November.

title.es: Apple detalla su prohibición de imágenes íntimas no consentidas generadas por IA
title.en: Apple details ban on AI-generated nonconsensual intimate imagery

body.es: Las App Review Guidelines actualizadas de Apple cubren explícitamente las imágenes íntimas no consentidas, incluidas las generadas con herramientas de IA, como contenido que las apps deben prevenir de forma proactiva. La norma también prohíbe apps con funciones ocultas o no documentadas que solo revelan capacidades dañinas tras ser aprobadas, una táctica conocida como bait-and-switch.
body.en: Apple's updated App Review Guidelines explicitly cover nonconsensual intimate imagery, including imagery generated with AI tools, as content apps must proactively prevent. The rule also bans apps with hidden or undocumented features that only reveal harmful capabilities after approval, a tactic known as bait-and-switch.

evidence.claim: Pornographic material, including apps that generate nudity or sexually explicit imagery without consent, are prohibited on the App Store.
Apps containing hidden or undocumented features, such as 'nudification' apps that only reveal harmful capabilities after approval, are prohibited on the App Store.
The App Review Guidelines are updated to explicitly cover nonconsensual intimate imagery, including imagery generated using AI tools.

title.es: Dudas sobre los requisitos de hardware de la nueva Siri con IA
title.en: Doubts raised over new AI Siri's hardware requirements

text.es: Apple justifica limitar la nueva Siri con IA a iPhone 15 Pro y modelos posteriores, con chip A17 Pro y 8 GB de memoria, por ejecutarse en gran parte de forma local. Algunos analistas señalan que Apple podría haber ofrecido una versión reducida para iPhones más antiguos en lugar de excluirlos por completo.
text.en: Apple justifies limiting the new AI Siri to iPhone 15 Pro and later models, with an A17 Pro chip and 8 GB of memory, because it runs largely on-device. Some analysts note Apple could have offered a scaled-down version for older iPhones instead of excluding them entirely.

evidence.claim: Apple's new Siri AI requires specific hardware to run locally on devices.
Apple's exclusion of Siri AI from older devices like the iPhone 11 is criticized for not offering a scaled-down version of the AI for these devices.

title.es: Una app de simulación acelera el diseño de baterías para camiones eléctricos
title.en: Simulation app speeds up electric truck battery design

text.es: Un consorcio que incluye a Volvo Trucks usó simulación multiescala basada en COMSOL y una app personalizada para optimizar el diseño y fabricación de baterías soldadas por láser, mejorando su robustez y vida útil para flotas eléctricas de largo alcance.
text.en: A consortium including Volvo Trucks used COMSOL-based multiscale simulation and a custom app to optimize the design and manufacturing of laser-welded battery packs, improving robustness and lifespan for long-range electric fleets.

evidence.claim: Volvo Trucks used a laser-welding simulation app to accelerate the design of long-lasting, high-performance batteries.
A consortium including Volvo Trucks optimized laser-welded battery pack design and manufacturing.
The optimization improved the robustness and lifetime of batteries for electric trucks.

title.es: El cifrado enfrenta presión creciente en todo el mundo

text.es: La ley de vigilancia planeada en Canadá se suma a una serie creciente de amenazas contra el cifrado que se extienden globalmente, según un análisis reciente.
text.en: Canada's planned surveillance law adds to a growing series of threats against encryption spreading worldwide, according to a recent analysis.

evidence.claim: Canada’s planned surveillance law is the latest in a series of threats to encryption.

title.es: Cómo Meta construyó Forum con ingeniería nativa de IA
title.en: How Meta built Forum with AI-native engineering

text.es: Forum, la nueva app de Meta para profundizar en conversaciones de grupos de Facebook, fue desarrollada por ingenieros que adoptaron una nueva forma de trabajar al incorporar un agente de IA directamente en el ciclo de desarrollo.
text.en: Forum, Meta's new app for going deeper into Facebook group conversations, was built by engineers who adopted a whole new way of working by bringing an AI agent directly into the development cycle.

evidence.claim: Meta’s newest app, Forum, is for anyone who wants to go deeper into the conversations in their Facebook groups.
Meta engineers adopted a whole new way of working by bringing an AI agent into the development cycle.
